name: sqlite-transfer-v1
selection_policy: No new selection or training; use all six original validation-selected checkpoints. Reconstruction permitted only if original tensor digests match exactly.
checkpoint_policy: Check file SHA256 and float32 tensor digest separately; tensor mismatch aborts before any external scoring. Report reconstructed artifact identity, never relabel as originally retained bytes.
data_policy: Full immutable raw docsrc .in bytes; no rendering, template execution, markup removal, normalization, prefix truncation or post-score document exclusion.
format_shift: Joint project/topic + source-markup shift: Flask RST to SQLite HTML-like/template .in source. Not a pure topic/domain intervention.
primary_metric: Token-weighted pooled byte NLL over all 52351 targets
analysis: All six runs and per-document scores; mean and sample SD across 3 fixed paired seeds. Descriptive only; no p-value, confidence interval, model selection, tuning or extra training budget.
